author: ahinzmann
body:
#### PR description:

This introduces a new digitizer for HGCAL scintillators. The code has been validated against 2025 CERN testbeam scintillator stack data and confirmed to reproduce the data. Most of the code was initially written by Daria Selivanova and presented at HGCAL DPG: https://indico.cern.ch/event/1709019/#20-sipm-on-tile-realistic-digi.
The structure of the code and how to distribute it among packages is to be discussed/changed. A cleanup of unused/outdated code is not done within this PR to keep it minimal. The new digitizer follows more closely the conventions used in the calibration data recorded during production quality control.

The changes applying only to the scintillator digitizazion and reconstruction can be summarized as follows:
- HGCDigisHEback are now in units of ADC counts (rather than MIPs)
- HGCDigisHEback are computed using the light yield, which depends on the tile size (parametrized during the production quality control) and the SiPM size (which is 9mm for the Phase2 detector), and the SiPM gain (which depends ConvGain=4 and Overvoltage=2V, set to what is expected for the Phase2 detector)
- In the shaper, the subtraction of tdc_onset from the TOT is disabled. Under the assumption that the TDC threshold will be set as low as possible close to ADC threshold, the TOT integrate over the whole time until the fall down to 80% of the peak. In the previous version the TOT was only computed starting from the rising up to 80% until the fall down to 80%, which in our understanding this is not how the HGCROC works.
- HGCHEBUncalibRecHits remains in units of MIPs. However, the unit of MIPs is changed to the MPV (455 keV) instead of Mean (675 keV)
- HGCHEBUncalibRecHits is reconstructed in the energy in units of MIPs making use of light yield and SiPM gain.
- Noise simulation is disabled for now. Needs to be done in a followup work.

#### PR validation:

This has been used to compare against 2025 CERN testbeam scintillator stack data and confirmed to reproduce the data.
https://indico.cern.ch/event/1751032/contributions/7359494/attachments/3385588/6081246/261119%20-%20SiPM-Stack-Testbeam-Simulation.pdf

Validation with the full Phase 2 detector simulation using runTheMatrix pending.
